run_rl_env_episodes: run Hanabi learning environment episodes with configurable players and agent class via argparse CLI
create_runner_class: create a Runner instance that initializes a Hanabi-Full environment with specified player count and agent type
test_simple_agent: test the SimpleAgent class as a player in a multi-agent Hanabi game episode loop

review_runner_run: review the Runner.run method that steps through episodes, collects observations, and tracks episode rewards
